standard-dialogue-before-the-blood-moon-.npc: Now you look like a vyre in need of some new threads.

steps.text: Shop interface for Darkmeyer Seamstress opens.

steps.npc: Oh yes. And luckily for you, I have everything you could ever need. Clothes, or the materials to make them if that's more your thing. All pre-scented as well.
Oh don't go acting like you don't know what I mean. You've done a decent job, but behind that scent, I can tell you're just a lowly vyre.
Fear not, I am no judge. I know that there are many like you who want a taste of upper class life. That's why all my outfits are scented. Helps you fit right in.

steps.player: Does it not bother you having lower class vampyres up here?

steps.npc: Me? No. As long as you've got money, I don't care who you are.
So, want to take a look?
I'll be here if you change your mind.

standard-dialogue-before-the-blood-moon-.npc: Human! Get back to the slave pens before I call the guards!
